Meal plan prices · 2026 How much does a meal plan cost in Dubai?

By the Messify team · Updated October 2026 · 5 min read

Quick answer

Compare meal plans by price per meal. Messify meal plans in Dubai cost AED 25.63 to 30.71 per meal: AED 215–610 a week or AED 715–1,999 a month for 1 to 3 meals a day. Diet and fitness plans with calorie tracking usually cost more per meal.

The number that matters: price per meal

Meal plans in Dubai are sold in very different ways: by the week, by the month, by calories or by number of meals. The only fair way to compare them is the price of one meal: plan price ÷ number of meals. Then check what that price includes, because delivery fees, VAT and how many days you get to use your meals change the real cost.

Broadly, Dubai meal plans fall into two groups. Diet and fitness plans (calorie-counted, macro-tracked, often with snacks and juices) cost the most per meal. Everyday meal plans, which replace ordering in or cooking, cost less and are built around normal home-style meals. Messify is an everyday meal plan.

Five things that change the real price

  1. Meals you actually eat. A cheap plan you can't fully use is expensive. Check how long you have to use your meals and whether you can skip days. With Messify you skip a day in the app and use that meal later in your plan.
  2. Delivery. Some services charge per delivery or per drop. Messify delivers all of the day's meals together every morning in one chilled bag.
  3. Menu variety. If you get bored by week two, you'll go back to ordering in. Messify's menu changes every day and you pick tomorrow's meals in the app by 6 PM.
  4. Dietary fit. Every Messify meal is 100% halal and there's a vegetarian option every day, for every meal.
  5. Where you live. Plans only help if they deliver to you. Messify meal plans deliver to Dubai Academic City, Dubai Silicon Oasis and International City.

Is a meal plan worth it?

If you mostly order in, a meal plan usually costs less per meal and removes the daily decision of what to eat. If you cook most of your meals and enjoy it, cooking is cheaper on ingredients. Many students and professionals in Dubai sit in between: no time or kitchen to cook properly, and tired of delivery apps. That's who an everyday meal plan is for.

Questions people ask

How much is a meal plan in Dubai per month?

It depends on the type of plan. Messify monthly plans cost AED 715 for 1 meal a day, AED 1,400 for 2 and AED 1,999 for 3, which works out to AED 25.63 to 27.50 per meal. Diet and fitness plans with calorie tracking usually cost more per meal.

What is the cheapest way to get a meal plan in Dubai?

Compare the price per meal, not the plan price. With Messify, the 3-meal monthly plan has the lowest price per meal, at AED 25.63. The 1-meal weekly plan, at AED 215, is the cheapest way to try it.

Is a weekly meal plan more expensive than a monthly one?

Per meal, yes. A Messify weekly plan costs AED 30.71 to 29.05 per meal, while monthly plans cost AED 25.63 to 27.50. Weekly plans are the easy way to try us first.

Do Messify prices include VAT?

Yes. Prices include VAT unless stated otherwise.

Can I skip days on a meal plan?

With Messify, yes. Skip a day in the app and use that meal on another day of your plan. Monthly plans give you 30 days to use 26 days of meals; weekly plans give you 9 days to use 7.
